title: New Zealand
description: In March 2026, my wife and I went to New Zealand's south island. This was the first trip with my new Nikon D7500 since the old one died in Costa Rica.

photos.alt: A mountain covered in fog across a lake with lamps on a pier in the foreground.

photos.description: In the hills near Queenstown. The sun was still rising behind some mountains, which is why the foreground is in shadow.
photos.alt: A silhouette of a bird on a palm tree with mountains in the background.

photos.description: Lots of birds on this trip. This isn't the most exciting but I like the framing.
photos.alt: A small brown bird on some rocks with a lake and mountains in the background.

photos.description: Mirror lakes on the way to Milford Sound. I couldn't find an angle that got as much of the lake and mountains together as I'd like, but this is ok.
photos.alt: A still lake with a reflection of mountains in the background.
A lake surrounded by tall mountains.

photos.description: The Lion in Milford Sound. I needed a wider angle lens.
photos.alt: A tall, snow-covered mountain rising above a lake.
A pigeon staring down from a tree.

photos.description: Taken while waiting at a crosswalk in Queenstown.
photos.alt: A crescent moon next to a mountain.

photos.description: This table apparently hasn't been used in a while.
photos.alt: A picnic table with flowers growing between the boards.

photos.description: A kākā in Orokonui Ecosanctuary. It was foggy and drizzling the whole time, which made for very moody lighting.
photos.alt: A silhouette of a kākā in a tree.

photos.description: It wanted us to move away from the feeding standing we were standing near.
photos.alt: A kākā cawing from a tree.

photos.description: There was a group of three on this roof and one kept chasing and biting the others.
photos.alt: Two kākā sitting on a roof while one bites at the other's foot.
Two takahē drinking from a pond while one stares at the camera.

photos.description: We visited a seal crèche and found this pup resting in the grass by the road.
photos.alt: A seal pup lying in tall grass.

photos.description: This elephant seal was mostly calm but didn't like when the gull got too close.
photos.alt: An elephant seal on a beach biting at a fleeing seagull.

photos.description: Nice ducks. I like the black and white.
photos.alt: Two paradise shell ducks standing on a grassy hill facing opposite directions.

photos.description: It was very windy so all the seals were resting on land. Several climbed pretty far up this hill.
photos.alt: A seal sleeping under a bush with the ocean in the background.

photos.description: Some nice flowers in the Larnach Castle gardens.
photos.alt: A close shot of a group of pink and green flowers.

photos.description: Also in the gardens. Not sure what this is but it looks cool.
photos.alt: A close up of a white plant with dew on it.
